name: Sentrook
description: Scans agent tool calls with Sentrook and allows, asks for approval, or blocks them.

scanUrl.description: Sentrook scan service base URL. Non-default values must be https on a firstdataunion.org host unless SENTROOK_DEV_ENDPOINTS=1.

rookeryUrl.description: Rookery base URL (same host rule as scanUrl).

oidcIssuer.description: Identity service issuer URL (same host rule as scanUrl).

clientId.description: Scan client id. Recommended: an env SecretRef to SENTROOK_SCAN_CLIENT_ID, with the value in the state-dir .env. Without it the plugin reads SENTROOK_SCAN_CLIENT_ID from the environment, then from the state-dir .env.

clientSecret.description: Scan client secret: an env SecretRef to SENTROOK_SCAN_CLIENT_SECRET, with the value in the state-dir .env, never the value itself. Without it the plugin reads SENTROOK_SCAN_CLIENT_SECRET from the environment, then from the state-dir .env.

mode.description: observe scores and logs every call but never blocks or asks.

reviewAt.description: Ask the user at or above this risk (default 45).

blockAt.description: Block at or above this risk (default 80).

scheduledTimeoutBehavior.description: What a cron or subagent review does when nobody answers (default deny). allow takes effect only on an OpenClaw release that honours a plugin approval's timeout behaviour; 2026.11.2 and older do not, and deny it anyway.

scope.description: persistent when absent. A config grant has no session, so scope session is never sent; /sentrook-grant adds session grants without editing config.

channelBindings.description: Channels this deployment normally delivers to; sent as destination grants. /sentrook-bind adds more without editing config.

skillReview.description: allow (default): OpenClaw's own background saves (the Skill Workshop review, the memory flush, the skill collection review) are sent as the host's, not the owner's, and their saves as self-edits judged against the conversation they came from. review: sent like any other call, as before. Any other value reads as allow.
